small_margin_rule: if any primary half gain is < 1 pp, a PASS is INCONCLUSIVE
title: Momentum book (breakout_gbb) with a pair-relative liquidity guard, with and without all-available entry
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26), model-free (no seed). Nothing adopted.
why: Offline on st_g24_mom's 5,300 trades (seen before registration): edge 0.104%/trade, flat-slippage break-even 0.074%/side vs cs_aro's 0.668%. Relative-volume confirmation (rvol >= 1.5/2.0) cuts P&L to 872/472 (worse). An absolute quote-volume floor raises edge per trade but at 30k USDT is 72% SOL+XRP (a pair filter in disguise). Pair-relative: the top third of each pair's own quote volume (full-sample terciles, lookahead) holds 3,181 of 3,485 USDT (0.261%/trade, break-even 0.117%) but late +33 only. This tests the causal version and whether it makes all-available entry pay on the momentum book.

arms.st_g24_mom_s4k: SimpleTrigger_BreakoutGbb_MomExit_G24 with startup_candle_count 4096, no guard, STAKE_SCALE 1: the warm-up null the guard needs
arms.st_g24_mom_liq: s4k + LIQUIDITY_GUARD {window 2880 (30 days of 15m), min_ratio 1.0}: keep a signal only where the signal candle's quote volume > the pair's trailing 2880-bar median (current candle included)
arms.st_g24_mom_liq3k: liq + STAKE_SCALE 3000/900: stake min(3000, fillable cap = quote volume / 10, max_stake = available wallet)

instrument: all 15 records per arm; liq: >= 99% of its trades' signal candles pass the guard offline (load_pair, same rolling median), >= 1 s4k trade fails it (the guard binds), trades in both halves, 0 position adds; liq3k: >= 80% of stakes equal min(3000, quote volume / 10) within 1%, and on trades shared with liq whose cap > 900 the median stake ratio liq3k / liq > 1. Fail -> that question INCONCLUSIVE, no P&L read

questions.QL1: judge_one(st_g24_mom_liq, st_g24_mom_s4k) PASS: the pair-relative liquidity guard improves the momentum book
questions.QL2: judge_one(st_g24_mom_liq3k, st_g24_mom_liq) PASS: all-available entry pays on the guarded book

returns_reading: pre-registered SECONDARY for both: Sharpe / maxDD ignored, labelled RETURNS-ONLY
reported: s4k vs st_g24_mom (warm-up effect); liq3k vs st_g24_mom; slippage re-score (research/tb_model/slippage_rescore method) at 0 / 2.5 / 5 bps per side and break-even per side for st_g24_mom, s4k, liq, liq3k; trades and median stakes
order: one chain: s4k, liq, liq3k backtests, then research.tb_model.liq
seen_before: the offline rvol / quote-volume / within-pair-tercile tables on st_g24_mom (scratchpad bo_filters.py)
no backtest of any arm here; the causal trailing-median ratio was not computed on any trades
question: Does keeping only the momentum signals on candles more liquid than the pair's own 30-day median raise the book's edge, and does that make all-available entry pay?
